retrievalProfile.description: A centered, cyan-toned photographic window set against a solid black field with expressive white script overlapping the top edge.
triggerTerms: monochrome blue photo on black background

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central rectangular photograph treated with a cyan/teal duotone filter. The photo is inset within a thick black border. Above the photo, white gestural script text spans the width, partially overlapping the black negative space and the top of the image frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Cyan-toned subject against a deep black void
Organic handwritten script contrasting with a rigid rectangular frame
Subject's gaze directed away from the viewer to create a pensive mood

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the left half of the central rectangular frame, scaled to a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the white script at the top, move down to the subject's face, and follow her gaze toward the right-side still life elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black border surrounding the central image, providing a heavy, somber frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the black void and the bright white text; low saturation within the cyan-toned image.

letterConstructionRules: Gestural, fast-moving strokes with visible pressure variation
Connected lowercase letters with sharp, angular transitions
Extended horizontal flourishes on terminal strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters are oversized and more aggressive in stroke weight
The 't' crossbars are elongated and slightly curved
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used for all text elements to maintain a personal, signature-like feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the gestural energy of the original lettering.
Maintains the personal, intimate tone of the design.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a centered rectangular photograph of a pensive woman in a room with still life objects, treated with a cyanotype/teal duotone filter, set against a solid black square background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply white gestural, handwritten script across the top third of the composition, ensuring the letters slightly overlap the top edge of the cyan photo.

verificationChecks: Does the text look like fast, expressive handwriting?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific decorative objects in the background

mustAchieve: High-contrast separation between text and background
Consistent cyan duotone across the entire inset image
Fluid, non-mechanical feel to the typography
avoid: Centered text that does not overlap the frame
Thin, delicate script that gets lost against the black

postGenerationChecks: Check that the cyan image is a perfect rectangle.
Ensure the white script is legible but expressive.
Verify no other colors besides black, white, and cyan are present.
Confirm the subject's expression is somber or pensive.
